stories.summary: NSW Building (Approvals and Practitioners) Act 2026 assented, replaces certifier system with staged approvals.
NSW releases 20-year Sydney Plan targeting 1.3 million new residents by 2046.
Lendlease sells $1bn+ retail stakes to Cbus Property, wins Redcliffe Hospital expansion contract.
Sydney Airport expansion plans approved, five-year initial delivery window.
Albanese lobbies Trump for full tariff exemption or rate freeze for Australia.
NSW commits $32.3m and AI licensing pilot to implement new Building Act; duty-of-care detail clarified.
Trump officials float capital-gains tax cut on primary home sales ahead of midterms.
Hyatt adds 37th brand, Hôtel Banke Opéra becomes Radisson Collection, Amàre Cancún opens under Curio by Hilton.
ApartmentIQ raises $25M from Susquehanna Growth Equity for AI multifamily intelligence platform.
Wonder food-hall/delivery concept closes $650M Series D at ~$9.65B valuation.
NSW Opposition criticises Labor's Sydney Plan for lacking matched transport-infrastructure funding.
Polling shows majority of Australians want falling house prices; analysts flag historic correction.
Lendlease FY26 profit halves to $38.6m; confirms exit from offshore development/construction to focus on Australia.
Albanese and Trump hold direct call on tariffs, developing the earlier exemption-lobbying story.
Looming ban on card surcharges forcing banks/merchants to rework payment pricing.
New NSW rental/tenancy law reforms take effect, strengthening tenant protections.
Labor's gambling ad restriction bill on track to pass parliament this week.
State data-centre energy/water use rules floated as potential national blueprint.
Apartments.com/CoStar raise US Q3 multifamily rent growth forecast to 1.4%.
NSW offers cash-for-guns buyback following firearm incident.
State of Origin confirmed for Auckland for the first time, next year.
Lendlease stock falls 5.9% post-earnings-call; Morningstar cuts growth outlook on FUM outflows despite new Japan/Malaysia mandates.
Microsoft cuts 4,800 jobs (2.1% of workforce) in commercial/Xbox restructure.
European economists warn AI-driven market rally is overdue a sharp correction.
Merit Beauty's first hospitality collaboration with Ritz-Carlton across seven properties.
Nvidia backs $105bn financing for OpenAI's Ohio data centre.
EQT to acquire Australian smart-parking tech provider Orikan.
Mirvac FY26 operating profit up 7% to $508m on stronger residential development.
Transgrid introduces six-part readiness test gating NSW grid capacity access for data centres.
New Building Act creates dedicated approval pathway for manufactured/prefab housing.
SBS: Australians face a decade longer, $275,000 dearer path to homeownership.
ABC links billionaire Phillip Lee's fortune to China corruption scandals; son hosted Albanese dinner.
US 30-year fixed mortgage rate rises to 6.69% per Bankrate/Freddie Mac.
Bloomberg: Asian retail savers piling into domestic stocks, reshaping home markets.
Bankstown Hospital $2bn redevelopment gets State Significant Development approval, builder appointed.
Ray Dalio tells Diary of a CEO that AI market shows classic 1929/2000-style bubble signs.
Australia summons Israeli ambassador over Frankcom notification failure.
NSW passes Fair Trading and Building Legislation Amendment Bill establishing LDI regime.
Bessent's bond-market intervention stirs inflation fears, gold prices spike.
Congress weighs doubling capital-gains exclusion on primary home sales.
Oyo tops 2026 global hotel brand rankings, reshuffling hierarchy.
BWH Hotels' Aiden brand expands past 20 hotels in development.
Marriott launches new Series brand in Greater China targeting ~100 hotels.
Meriton Suites launches branded SuiteDreams mattress.
HSRA shortlists six partners for civils works and rolling stock on the 194km Sydney-Newcastle high-speed line.
NSW opens fast-track approval scheme for data centres meeting new environmental/efficiency standards.
Dow drops 700+pts, Nasdaq -1% mid-week on Treasury yield spike, partial rebound Friday.
SK Hynix pursues $28bn US listing to capture AI memory-chip demand.
McKinsey State of Consumer 2026 finds trade-down behaviour evolving into creative value-seeking.
Diary of a CEO episode with Brian Greene on AI consciousness, free will and reality.
